extracted.intended_audience: literary critics, students and scholars of short fiction, editors, and informed readers of short-story collections
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and evaluative principles for judging short stories and collections (including translations), focusing on technique, tone, structure, characterization, atmosphere, and editorial selection. Useful for critics, anthologists, and students of short-story construction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical excellence / technique
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories may be 'redeemed by ... excellent technique' even when content is weak or mawkish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical skill (polishing, control of form and craft) can compensate for weaker subject matter; volumes of technical interest are valuable to students of short-story construction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vividness of portraiture
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'vividness of their portraiture' is singled out as a reason to mention otherwise non-artistic, propagandist sketches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strong, vivid character or scene portraits make sketches memorable and worth preserving even if not high art; such vividness contributes to lasting impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Passion and social/political engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'passion of their challenge to the existing social order' justifies notice of works written with propagandist intention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A collection's engagement with social issues (passionate challenge) is a valuable dimension and can warrant attention despite lack of pretension to 'art.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Strength of central idea vs execution
rubrics_metrics.description: There may be 'more to be said for the idea which prompted these stories than for the success with which the idea has been carried out.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate both the conceptual originality or premise of a volume and the effectiveness of its execution; a strong idea with poor realization is an evaluative negative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professionalism / amateurishness of contributors
rubrics_metrics.description: A 'frankly amateurish spirit' among contributors undermines a collective volume.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anthologies or collaborative volumes should be judged on the professionalism and consistent quality of contributors; editors should 'choose his contributors more carefully.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriateness of framing device / structure
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'Decameron structure' was 'artificially imposed after the stories were written' and should be abandoned if inappropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorial or framing devices must fit the material; an artificial structure can detract from otherwise good stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sentiment vs sentimentality
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories can be 'studies in sentiment' yet 'successfully avoid sentimentality' for the most part.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish genuine sentiment—insightful humane feeling—from mawkish or excessive sentimentality; the former is a strength, the latter a flaw.

rubrics_metrics.name: Atmospheric values / setting
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain stories are praised as 'fine studies in atmospheric values' and recommended for anthologies on that ground.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Atmosphere (mood, setting, tone) is a major criterion; strong atmospheric rendering can make stories anthology-worthy even if short in scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional tone and sympathetic depth
rubrics_metrics.description: Works possessing 'poetic grace and gentle vision' and a 'fine human sympathy' are positively reviewed even if somewhat veiled or aloof.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess the emotional stance and depth of sympathy; a subtler, veiled human sympathy can still produce profound effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Felicity in portraying social life / realism
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'genuine talent for the felicitous portrayal of social life in an English village' is singled out as revealing an author's promise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Realistic, felicitous depiction of social milieus and local life is an important measure of a short-story writer's power.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dramatic finality / effective endings
rubrics_metrics.description: Some younger writers 'have such a command of dramatic finality'—a quality that makes stories memorable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluators should note how effectively a story achieves an ending that feels inevitable, dramatic, or resonant; mastery of dramatic finality marks accomplished short-story writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tonal appropriateness and medium fit
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories 'might have been told with advantage in a more quiet tone' and an 'instinctive dramatist' may be using the wrong medium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge whether the author's tone and chosen literary medium suit the material; mismatch (e.g., overwrought dramatism in short fiction) can lessen effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity without conventional plot / experimental form
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories 'have no plot, no climax, no direct characterization' yet display 'a special unity of its own woven around the spiritual relations of his heroes.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-traditional structures should be evaluated for internal coherence and unity; absence of conventional plot/climax is acceptable when a different organizing principle yields unity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation quality and faithfulness
rubrics_metrics.description: Translations are praised when they 'transfer the poetry' or criticized as 'wretchedly translated' when they obscure original art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess translations both for fidelity to original tone/style and for literary quality in the target language; translation can make or break reception, though great originals may still show through poor translations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coloring / stylistic distinction
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories may be notable for a 'certain distinction of coloring' or 'brilliant coloring' apparent even in translation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate the writer's imagery, color, and stylistic distinctiveness as a separate aesthetic dimension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Melodramatic technique and emotional economy
rubrics_metrics.description: Some volumes are 'frankly melodramatic' yet show 'hard polished technique' and can 'wring the last drop of emotion' from situations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Melodrama can be a legitimate, technically accomplished mode; reviewers should decide if emotional intensity is artful or merely excessive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value for students / pedagogical usefulness
rubrics_metrics.description: Volumes with exemplary technique (even of melodrama or genre) are 'valuable to students of short story construction.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider whether a book is instructive about craft (structure, technique, genre practice), irrespective of literary stature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character presentation: dialogue vs personal statement
rubrics_metrics.description: An author 'presents his characters more directly, and achieves his revelation through dialogue rather than personal statement.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate methods of characterization—direct presentation, dialogue-driven revelation, or narrative exposition—and their effectiveness for each story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on motive vs plot action
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain writers are 'much less interested in the surface movement of plot than in the relentless search for motive.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether a story's emphasis on psychological motive rather than external plot produces depth or diffuses dramatic momentum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Breadth, selection, and critical apparatus in anthologies
rubrics_metrics.description: Collections are praised for ranging 'over a wide field' and including 'a valuable historical and critical introduction, with biographical notes, and a critical apparatus.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anthologies should be judged on representativeness, editorial selection, and the inclusion of scholarly/contextual material that enhances educational use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowance for technical inadequacy in young or emergent traditions
rubrics_metrics.description: For literatures with a 'young tradition' one must 'allow more than usual for technical inadequacy' when the substance is remarkable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Critics should balance technical shortcomings against the cultural/substantive value of works from emerging literatures and not penalize them unduly for immaturity of form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparative and market considerations (publication & exposure)
rubrics_metrics.description: Several foreign volumes 'should be promptly introduced to the American public' and mentions are made in hopes of reaching 'a friendly publisher's eye.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of critical evaluation includes considering a work's suitability and potential impact for new markets and advocating for worthy but underexposed writers.
